title: Token usage
bar.tooltip: Today's tokens · click for usage · right-click to refresh
error: Wakapi is unavailable. Check your connection, then click Refresh. The plugin uses your existing WakaTime configuration.
stale: Offline · showing a saved snapshot from the time below. This is not live usage.
partial: Some panels are unavailable. Available panels are shown; see Sources for details.
mix.title: Where the tokens went
trend.title: Token activity
empty.tokens: No recorded tokens in this period.
coding.title: AI vs manual · tracked time
coding.note: Time is classified from Wakapi activity. It does not measure code authorship. The bar shows AI-only, manual-only, then overlap; each total above includes overlap.
coding.noManual: No manual editor activity was recorded in this period. This does not establish that all code was AI-written.
cost.note: At your server's configured rates. An estimate of equivalent API value, not a bill or subscription spend.
models.title: Tokens by model
agents.title: Tokens by tool
agents.note: Line changes below are agent-reported edits, not an authorship percentage. Tools may omit this field; zero means no changes were reported.
projects.title: Projects
projects.note: Token attribution follows the first observed project for copied events. Unassigned usage stays visible. Time and tokens are independent measures.
unavailable: No data is available for this panel in this period.
activity.title: Coding activity
rhythm.title: When you code
rhythm.hint: Hover a cell · hours use your Wakapi account's timezone
rhythm.overlap: Heatmap sums agent and manual activity; simultaneous activity can overlap. The streak looks back beyond the selected period.
sources.title: Tracking sources · latest status
sources.note: This view uses your server's counted token ledger, which deduplicates copied events and excludes held fallback observations. Machines below show current status across all periods.
coverage.title: Coverage and accounting
sources.refresh: Auto refresh reads your configured Wakapi server (HTTPS, or HTTP on localhost) every 5 minutes for the bar and every minute while this panel is open. Pause it with Auto. No API keys are copied into the plugin. Only aggregate snapshots are cached locally.
footer.range: %1 – %2 · calendar days in your Wakapi timezone
footer.updated: Updated %1 · 1–4: period · Tab: view · R: refresh · Esc: close
footer.keys: 1–4: period · Tab: view · R: refresh · Esc: close
coding.share: AI active during %1% of tracked time · manual editor active during %2% (overlap included)
